caveats: Only Lectures 1-6 of 19 are covered; the KB cannot answer questions about the technical content of Lectures 7-19.
Lecture 1's recording leaves out the course-logistics slides (5-6 and 10-15); their content comes from the slides alone.
Lecture 2's recording ends after slide 21; slides 22-27 (collecting demonstrations, the embodiment gap, the summary) come from the slides alone.
Lecture 3's recording does not discuss slide 2's reminders and skips the KL constraint on slide 25 for time; that constraint comes from the slides alone.

Lecture 4's recording ends on the review slide (23); its slides 24-37 (off-policy actor-critic, replay buffers, soft actor-critic, the SAC-versus-PPO chart, the closing slides) are not discussed in that recording, but Lecture 5 teaches the same material aloud from a revised deck.

Lecture 5's recording covers slides 3-28; slide 2's reminders and slides 29-30 (plan recap, next time) come from the slides alone. Several steps (a KL-penalized objective, the clipping written out, the recursive Q-function) were worked on a board the recording does not show and are reconstructed from the spoken words.

Lecture 6's recording covers slides 3-29; slide 2's reminders and slide 29's next-week topics come from the slides alone. Slide 7's thought exercise is answered while pointing at the slide, and the algorithm is written on a board the recording does not show; the wiki reconstructs both from the spoken words and says so. Slides 24-25 print the n-step target's discount exponent as t - t', which the wiki notes as an apparent slip.

Transcripts are copy-edited from YouTube auto-captions; students are inaudible, so their questions appear only as the lecturer restates them. Lectures 1 and 2 each have three passages marked [Ed: unclear], Lecture 3 one, Lecture 4 two, Lecture 5 five (plus four flagged restorations). Lecture 6's captions are much noisier: 53 of its 80 paragraphs carry [Ed:] notes, mostly on garbled board dictation and mis-heard notation.
The verbatim captions are not committed; each transcript says how to regenerate them.
